subject: Finova — Decision criteria: latency, cost, deployment & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>, Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Finova — Decision criteria: latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning — it was really helpful to walk through Finova's high-level use cases and constraints. Per our discussion, I wanted to recap the open items and ask for a few clarifications so we can map the right deployment and pricing options internally.

Key items we covered:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + intent routing (short requests) and monthly batch reports (longer generations).
- Expected volume: pilot ~100k requests/month, production target ~1.2M requests/month (mix of short/long).
- Security preference: prod should be isolated (VPC/private) if possible.

Open clarifications (please confirm):
1) Latency targets: you mentioned wanting p95 for short requests under ~250ms and for longer generations p95 under ~800ms — can you confirm?
2) Cost targets: do you have a target amortized cost per 1k tokens or per inference that would be a pass/fail for procurement?
3) Deployment mode: pilot okay on Hosted API, but is the preference to move to Private (VPC) for production? Any constraints about on-prem or cloud-only?
4) SLA requirements: is 99.9% minimum acceptable? Any specific uptime or incident response time commitments required by procurement/legal?
5) Procurement/Legal contacts: who will be the procurement/contracting owner (name + email) and is there a PO template or procurement portal Finova requires?

Next steps proposed from our side:
- Rishi will put together a pilot architecture + cost estimate for both Hosted and Private options.
- I'll draft a one-page decision criteria summary for your stakeholders (latency, cost, SLA, security).
- If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to align on the economic buyer and procurement path.

Thanks — appreciate a confirmation on the five items above and any docs you can share (procurement template, security questionnaire).

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@finova.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@finova.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@finova.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finova — Decision criteria: latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the clear list. Quick answers below (happy to expand in the follow-up):

1) Latency targets:
- Short requests (support summarization / routing): p95 target <= 250ms.
- Long generations (batch reports / summaries): p95 target <= 800ms.

2) Cost targets:
- We're aiming for an amortized cost of <= $2 per 1k tokens for the primary production workload. If cost is higher, procurement will flag it for additional approvals.

3) Deployment mode:
- Pilot: Hosted API is fine.
- Production: preference for Private (VPC) deployment in our AWS account for data isolation. On-prem is not required at this stage.

4) SLA:
- Minimum expectation: 99.9% uptime.
- Support: standard SRE-style incident response with a 4-hour critical response SLA preferred.

5) Procurement/legal:
- Procurement owner: Lena Park <lena.park@finova.com>.
- Legal/InfoSec contact: Mark Chen <mark.chen@finova.com>.
- I'll attach our security questionnaire and PO template for your team.

Attached: Finova_Security_Questionnaire.pdf, Finova_PO_template.docx

Let me know if you'd like us to loop in any additional stakeholders for the next meeting. We're targeting an internal decision window of ~3 weeks (pilot approval -> budget sign-off).

Thanks,
Alex
Principal Product Manager
Finova
alex.johnson@finova.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@finova.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finova — Decision criteria: latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Alex — really helpful, thanks for the quick answers and the attachments (I downloaded the questionnaire).

I'll map the stakeholders on our side and propose the following owners for the mutual action plan:
- Economic buyer / budget owner: Priya Sinha (you confirmed).
- Procurement owner: Lena Park.
- Legal/InfoSec: Mark Chen.

Rishi (cc'd) — could you assemble a short pilot architecture doc (1 pager) that shows:
- Hosted pilot config (instance sizes, expected p95s for short/long requests) + cost estimate
- Private (VPC) deployment outline (networking, KMS integration) + incremental cost delta
- SLA options (99.9% vs 99.95%) and associated pricing impact

Priya / Alex — would you be available for a 30-min alignment next Tuesday or Thursday (we're flexible)? I'll send a calendar invite once we pick a time.

I'll also prepare a concise 'decision criteria' one-pager that highlights the latency/cost/SLA tradeoffs so you can share with procurement and engineering.

Best,
Marissa

From: Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@finova.com>, Mark Chen <mark.chen@finova.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finova — Decision criteria: latency, cost, deployment & next steps

Thanks Marissa / Alex —

Those targets look right. A couple of notes from the economic buyer side:
- Budget: we've provisionally allocated funds for the pilot; production budget approval is contingent on the cost estimate falling within the $2/1k tokens target or a clear ROI case.
- Procurement process: Lena will run the PO and legal review. We generally require a PO + standard MSAs; DocuSign link will be our source of truth.
- Timeline: we're aiming for a final vendor decision in ~3 weeks, pilot to start within 6 weeks pending legal/procurement.

I've uploaded our PO template and added a placeholder DocuSign envelope: https://www.docusign.com/finova/agreement/12345

Happy to take the 30-min sync — Tue/Thu both work for me.

Best,
Priya Sinha
VP, Customer Experience
Finova
priya.sinha@finova.com

Subject: Re: Finova — Decision criteria: latency, cost, deployment & next steps — confirmed next steps

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick alignment. Summary / next steps (action owners):

2) Marissa (Redwood) — one-page decision criteria summary for Finova stakeholders (latency, cost, SLA, security) to share with procurement. Target: Tuesday 2026-09-01.
3) Alex / Priya / Lena (Finova) — confirm preferred times for a 30-min sync next Tue/Thu and share any additional security docs.
